name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
one_liner: A free, 523-lesson online course that teaches anyone to build and ship real AI products, step by step, in plain English.
buyer: A bootcamp operator or corporate L&D manager who needs a ready-made AI-engineering curriculum instead of writing one from scratch.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp licenses the lesson structure as the backbone of a paid 12-week 'AI Engineer' cohort, adding live mentorship on top of the free material.
A corporate trainer runs an internal 'AI upskilling' workshop series for a non-tech company's engineers, using the roadmap as the syllabus and charging per seat.
A YouTuber records a paid 'watch me build every lesson' companion series with code reviews and office hours for viewers who want accountability.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a cohort-based course with live mentorship built on top of the free curriculum.
Offer corporate team-training workshops using the roadmap as the syllabus.

steal_this: Turn the roadmap into a paid 4-week 'accountability cohort' with a private Discord and weekly live code review — the content is already written, you're selling structure and feedback.
